note: Volume allowance required per conductor, 18 AWG through 6 AWG, both printed unit columns transcribed verbatim (cm3 canonical for the engine, in3 informational — do not re-derive one from the other; the printed 6 AWG value is 81.9 cm3, while derivative calculator sites show a re-derived 82.0, which is rejected). The table was designated Table 314.16(B) through NEC 2020 and renamed Table 314.16(B)(1) in the 2023 restructuring that added (B)(6) Terminal Block Fill; values are unchanged 2008 through 2026 (the only 2026 change to 314.16 is an explicit exemption for splicing connectors, no table changes per published change summaries).
